recognize_zh: 這是 Sanger 定序的色層圖（chromatogram），標示欄位是單一乾淨的峰，未見雙峰，代表為同型合子（homozygous）位點；圖中所示序列並未標註基因座標，需對照報告確認 SEC23B c.1385A>G 變異。
features: Sanger sequencing electropherogram with base calls above color-coded peaks
Highlighted position shows a single clean peak without an overlapping second peak (homozygous call)
Local sequence reads TTGGCATCT[A]TTTTGAAGTT around positions 70-80
Clean baseline with well-separated peaks and no background noise
Base call at the highlighted position is displayed as A (green peak), not G
describe_en: This figure is a Sanger sequencing electropherogram rather than a morphologic image. The highlighted nucleotide shows a single, clean peak without a superimposed second peak, consistent with a homozygous genotype at that position, and the surrounding trace is of good quality. Note that the base call displayed at the highlighted position is A (green peak) within a TAT codon context, whereas the reported variant is SEC23B c.1385A>G (p.Tyr462Cys); the panel lacks coordinates and strand orientation, so the reported homozygous change cannot be verified from this image alone and should be confirmed against the annotated report. Biallelic SEC23B pathogenic variants cause congenital dyserythropoietic anemia type II.
